topic: DIDs (Data Identifiers) Internal Parameter Data Identifiers for Left Turn Signal Light Control
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific internal parameter data identifier related to the left turn signal light control system, including its description, value mapping, default value, remarks, and associated ECU.

column_semantics.Short Name: The short name of the data identifier, used for quick reference in documentation and testing.
column_semantics.Description: A textual explanation of the parameter's purpose or function within the system.
column_semantics.Value Table: Lists the possible values of the parameter and their corresponding meanings or states.
column_semantics.Default: The default value of the parameter when no other value is specified.
column_semantics.Remark: Additional notes or context about the parameter, such as usage scenarios or storage behavior.
column_semantics.ECU: The Electronic Control Unit responsible for managing this parameter.

core_entities.name: LDirLghtOpenCtrlRsn
core_entities.description: Identifier for the reason why the left turn signal light is turned on.

core_entities.name: LHZ CU
core_entities.description: The Electronic Control Unit responsible for handling the left turn signal light control.

core_conditions.name: 0x00
core_conditions.description: No specific reason for the left turn signal light being on.

core_conditions.name: 0x01
core_conditions.description: The left turn signal light is on due to the direction light switch being activated.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the internal parameter data identifiers for monitoring and diagnosing the reasons behind the activation of the left turn signal light. It can be used to verify that the system correctly records and reports the cause of the light being on, particularly whether it was triggered by the driver via the direction light switch.
